title: Financial dashboard
prompt: Design and build the main dashboard for our fintech app: portfolio overview, recent transactions, spending by category chart, and alerts. React + TypeScript + Tailwind. Users check it daily.

must: Product-surface register: clarity, density, states; DESIGN_VARIANCE <= 6
Tabular numerals for money; semantic colors reserved for meaning; never color-only signals
Loading/empty/error states for every data region; skeletons mirror layout
Motion minimal (frequency gate: daily use); no decorative dashboard animations
Neutral, precise register in copy; no playful microcopy on money
must_not: Demo data presented as real without an example label
Chart palette failing contrast or relying on hue alone
